identity.name: Day-Date 40
identity.one_liner: The Day-Date 40 in yellow gold, launched 2015 with caliber 3255.

provenance_events.description: The 228238 is the modern 40mm yellow-gold Day-Date 40 — the 36mm 118238 replaced by the larger 40mm case that became the brand's most-photographed Day-Date.

narrative.story: The 228238 introduced the Day-Date 40 as the flagship of Rolex's 2015 movement generation: the 3255 with Chronergy escapement, 70-hour reserve, and a case that replaced the short-lived Day-Date II. In yellow gold with a champagne dial it continues the 'President' image the model has carried since 1956.
narrative.collector_notes: Dial choice is the market variable — champagne and green dials trade strongest in yellow gold. Gold cases show desk wear readily; check bracelet stretch and case edges.
